title: .harness-goodies/estimation.json
description: The Story Point scale of one project's estimates, and its anchor. Each feature has its own file in `.harness-goodies/estimations/` (feature.schema.json).

anchor.description: The SP that a number of planned hours equals (default 13 SP = 75 h, about one developer's two-week sprint). It sets where a comparison starts for a feature with planned hours and cross-checks every saved SP; it never decides a size. Off when absent, null, {} or with hours null or 0, and on a scale that is not all numbers. estimate.py checks that sp is a value of the scale.
